messages:
Harper (CS): Drafting a short field play for a 48h warmup to reduce cold starts and limit noisy retries for renewal-risk tenants. Keeping it 3 steps + quick checks.
Eli (FieldOps): Need copyable commands and a fallback plan. Short and executable.
Harper (CS): OK pasteable plan below. Use in your runbook.
1) Seed KV (30m before traffic shift): run 3 unique seed prompts for top 6 endpoints. Example: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -d '{"prompt":"Seed: welcome","max_tokens":20,"mode":"warm_seed"}'
```
2) Ramp with small batches: enable prefill with TTL=300s, set batch_window_ms=30 and max_prefill_concurrency=4. Observe errors; if error_rate > 6% toggle prefill off.
3) Streaming validation & deterministic degrade: confirm streaming path for user flows (timeout 800ms). If streaming fails, switch to smaller quantized model with batch_window_ms=100 for 60s, then enqueue async and notify customer.
Kai (SRE): Add health probe for the field team (off by default): GET /v0/health/warmup -> {"status":"ok","last_seed":"ts","cache_hits":N}. Also recommend circuit_breaker:0.9 and auto-disable seeding when error_rate>=0.06.
Rox (Solutions): For onboarding, collect a short prompt pack: 8 happy-path, 4 edge, 3 adversarial. Attach 5 failure exemplars to the shared issue so Eval can triage.
Health Bot: Reminder: tag traces with "cs:warmup:<acct>" and include a tag "cs:renewal-risk" for reporting.
Harper (CS): Quick checklist for on-call (copyable):
- Start seed 30m pre-cutover (3 prompts)
- Enable prefill (TTL=300s) for top endpoints
- Run synthetic ramp: 60s at 50qps, watch lat/err
- If err_rate >6%: disable prefill, flip to fallback model + queue
- Upload one slow trace + one failed generation per 12h
Eli (FieldOps): Perfect. I'll paste into the customer's playbook and run Day0.
Harper (CS): I'll publish the 1-pager in onboarding kit and tag the AS ticket. Closing thread.
